Or maybe the game is: the framed quadrant's icon is the target, and I need to make one of the other quadrants' icons match it by clicking the red diagonal tiles? But clicking tiles didn't do anything...
Wait, maybe I need to click the icon's corners (the 2x2 blocks) to toggle them, and the goal is to make all icons match the framed one? Let me try clicking the g corner of the TL icon. For example, the top-left g at (10,12).
